properties.name: Shenandoah + GWJ National Forest (Pilot Region)
properties.description: Pilot ingestion region: Shenandoah National Park + George Washington & Jefferson National Forest (Lee, Massanutten, Deerfield Ranger Districts). Covers the northern Appalachian spine from Waynesboro VA north to Front Royal VA.
properties.bbox_comment: [west, south, east, north] in decimal degrees (WGS84)
properties.min_fetch_counts_comment: Per-source raw-fetch floors (a source fetching below its floor aborts the run BEFORE any load/prune — a truncated/partial fetch can't self-wipe). Keys match registry source names; conservative lower bounds (well under known-good fetch counts) sized to catch gross truncation without false-tripping. Env-overridable per source via ADVENTURE_FETCH_MIN_<SOURCE>.
